purpose: Administrative template only; never loaded at startup. Preserve existing fixed versions. Supply credentials and sell prices in the operator session.
publication_order: Resolve and bind the canonical TypeSafe vendor internal_id, then register jev-1.14.
Create or update a TypeSafe source while preserving existing models and mappings; keep new routing disabled until tested.
Save provider costs through the source update endpoint; set an explicit sell price through the pricing API.
Probe jev-1.14 and a PNG asset request with reported usage, then enable routing and verify discovery.

model_registration.description_en: Jev 1.14: multilingual noul, choice and score decisions with experimental PNG/JPEG assets. Box and long context are not supported by this gateway.
model_registration.description_zh: Jev 1.14：多语言概率、选择和评分判别，支持实验性 PNG/JPEG assets；网关暂不支持 Box 和长上下文。

optional_alias.policy: Register and price separately only to intentionally follow TypeSafe releases. Never remap fixed versions to latest. Validate other providers separately.

required_bindings.model_registration.vendor_id: Resolve the canonical TypeSafe vendor internal_id.
required_bindings.sell_price: Set the intended customer price; provider cost does not define the sell price.
required_bindings.channel_capacity: Set channel and shared account RPS/in-flight limits from the account allocation, sharing the existing account group where appropriate.

price_units.channel_provider_cost_prices.input_per_m: USD per million input tokens, including images in provider usage.input_tokens.
